title: Nabiyyoota Keessatti Lubbuu Lallaafaa
intro: Sagaleen gara qajeelummaatti waamicha godhu tokko keeyyattoota Qur’aana kabajamaa keessaa ni dhaga’ama. Lubbuun eebbifamtuu kun yeroo Ijoollee Israa’el biratti qajeelfamni baay’ee barbaachisutti raajii fi macaafa waaqaa kan kennameef ture. Namni dhuunfaa kun kallattiin ummata isaaniitti dubbatee, gara yaadannoo Gooftaa isaaniitti isaan kakaasaa ture. Obsaa fi of kennuudhaan ibsaa ifa seenaan isaanii fuula macaafa qulqulluu ibsu ta’an. Nama dinqisiisaa maqaan isaa Qur’aanaa fi Wangeela keessatti kabajame kana adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Yeroo sabni koo rakkina keessa turetti raajii fi kitaaba samiin kabajameera.
Harmeen tiyya haala ajaa'ibsiisaa ta'een, ajaja Rabbii qofaan na deesse.
'Yaa Ilmaan Israa'el! Ani ergamaa Rabbii sitti ta’ee, waan na dura dhufe mirkaneessudha’ jedheen.
Nabiyyii maqaan isaa Ahmad ta’u oduu gammachiisaa fideen mallattoo ifa ta’e Gooftaa kee biraa qabadheen dhufe.
Harmeen koo dubartii qajeeltuu dargaggummaa koo irraa kaasee tajaajila Rabbiif na kennite turte.
Rabbiin Qur’aana na barsiisee haadha kootiif akkan mararfatuu fi dirqama na godhe, of tuultuu ykn ajajamuu diduus hin turre.

identity.label: Ani Eenyu?
options: Nabi Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
